speaker: Gate Clerk
text: The courier station burned before dawn. Choose carefully whom you trust.

speaker: Captain Lien
text: I saw a masked rider leave the northern track before the smoke rose.

speaker: Captain Lien
text: I heard there was a rider, but I never saw the face myself.

speaker: Scholar Vu
text: The dispatch ledger names a third seal that should not exist.

speaker: Scholar Vu
text: Without the ledger, all I have is rumor.

speaker: Warden Pham
text: Whatever road brought you here, Stone Gate is where the stories meet.

speaker: Masked Courier
text: You are asking who carried the message. Ask instead who wrote it.
